claim: On VelaNext Linux/WSL2, verified native restic0.19.1 recovered both exact synthetic snapshots through a fresh SSH connection after isolated wrong-password and corrupt-copy failures. Complete fixture path/type/byte/hash/POSIX-mode equality passed, including the fixture root.
limitations: No pruning, services, global PATH/configuration changes, credential access, model calls, reboot, or shared SSH transport changes.
Fresh-SSH recovery after explicit incorrect-input/corruption failures; process-crash and power-loss recovery not qualified.
Same-host password-file availability is a prerequisite; independent key recovery and offhost disaster recovery remain unknown.
No token, storage-efficiency or backup performance claim.
Prior direct-subtree restore returned0 but failed the strict fixture-root mode gate. That attempt remains failed; the parent-subtree correction is a separate native run.
A fresh SSH connection proves channel-independent access with the retained local task key only; future same-host key availability, key-loss recovery and offhost disaster recovery remain unknown.
Native gitleaks and Worktrunk were absent in the bounded lookup and were not installed or qualified by this lane.
The corrected reusable run.py/plan.json combine the observed fixes; they were not replayed as a third full backup trial. Actual executed runner/plan bytes are retained per attempt.
Ten offline oracle/guard tests are distinct from the actual native restic commands.

failed_attempts_retained.failure: Read-only copied pack rejected corruption write; corrected only copied pack owner-write mode.
Direct-subtree restore returned0 but fixture root mode was0700 instead of0750; parent-subtree correction reused exact snapshots and unchanged oracle.

data.key_scope: New task-only random passwords remained regular mode0600 files in the private WSL lane; no key or password content is published. Future same-host key availability and offhost recovery remain unknown.

transport.method: Separate foreground SSH invocations with ControlMaster=no and ControlPath=none
transport.boundaries: No host reboot, client credential migration, network routing change, shared SSH service change or transport interruption was performed.
